course.title: Starter Unit 2 Keep Tidy!【例句】
course.description: SECTION B Where do you put your things?

sentences.content: A schoolbag is on the desk.
sentences.english: A schoolbag is on the desk

sentences.content: Some books are in the box.
sentences.english: Some books are in the box

sentences.content: A pair of socks is under the bed.
sentences.english: A pair of socks is under the bed

sentences.content: Mum, I can't find my new cap.
sentences.english: Mum , I can't find my new cap
sentences.chinese: 妈妈，我找不到我的新帽子了。

sentences.content: Your new cap? What colour is it?
sentences.english: Your new cap ? What colour is it ?
sentences.chinese: 你的新帽子？是什么颜色的？

sentences.content: Oh, here it is. It's under your desk.
sentences.english: Oh , here it is . It's under your desk
sentences.chinese: 哦，原来在这儿。它在你的桌子下面。

sentences.content: You need to keep your room tidy.
sentences.english: You need to keep your room tidy

sentences.content: I can't find my new glasses.
sentences.english: I can't find my new glasses
sentences.chinese: 我找不到我的新眼镜了。
它们是什么颜色的，爸爸？

sentences.content: Now I see them! Dad, they're on your head!
sentences.english: Now I see them ! Dad , they're on your head !
sentences.chinese: 现在我看见它们了！爸爸，它们在你头上！
